consequence.statement: Annotations with extra white spaces between namespaces in the exportTo annotation are now accepted without failure.

original.statement: The networking.istio.io/exportTo annotation now accepts extra white spaces between namespaces.

decision.reason: [ev-1252a2a51c0c] describes an addition that relaxes parsing: users may now put extra white spaces between namespaces in the networking.istio.io/exportTo annotation. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected or changes for configurations that already work. An environment that does nothing therefore needs no work, so "none" (informational) is the right kind, and the proposed statement matches the evidence.
